_comment: Single source of truth for per-role model defaults in the adversarial harness. Distributable via make sync-local → .cursor/harness-model-routing.json. See .harness/docs/research/model-selection.md for full rationale.

planner.rationale: Planner task length is moderate; inherit keeps cost proportional to the user's chosen builder model. Override to 'auto' (server-resolved frontier) for architectural decomposition work with 3+ files or vague scope — reasoning models produce cleaner task boundaries with explicit scope inclusions/exclusions.
planner.when_to_override: Complex architectural tasks (3+ files, vague scope). Leave as inherit for simple tasks — harness-gate.sh bypass path handles those without the planner.

builder.rationale: Builder is the main agent, not a subagent. Its model is the user's IDE session choice. Not settable via frontmatter. Programmatic routing (SDK Agent.create with model=) is the only path to builder model control — see feat-13b in the backlog.
builder.when_to_override: Not applicable. Use the strongest model available in your IDE session for complex implementation tasks.

evaluator.rationale: Evaluator's primary failure mode is sycophancy — approving work it should reject. Stronger reasoning models resist approval bias and are more willing to produce FAIL with specific command-output evidence. 'auto' lets Cursor resolve the best available frontier model for the account plan. Cost is bounded: evaluator runs once per build task, not per turn.
evaluator.when_to_override: No override needed — auto is the default. Downgrade to a specific model ID only if cost is a concern.

override_path.personal: Edit .cursor/agents/[role].md (after make sync-local). Change model: inherit to model: auto. Note: make sync-local overwrites .cursor/agents/ — re-apply after each sync.
override_path.team_default: Edit library/cursor/agents/[role].md directly. Everyone who runs make sync-local inherits the routing. This is the recommended path for team deployments.
override_path.warning: Distributable defaults in library/cursor/agents/ stay as model: inherit. Do not change them without team agreement — consumers on restricted plans may hit silent model fallbacks.

platform_constraints.silent_fallback: Cursor overrides model: field without error when: (1) team admin has blocked the model, (2) Max Mode required but not enabled, (3) model not on current plan. Use 'auto' instead of specific model IDs to minimize fallback risk.
platform_constraints.builder_not_settable: Builder model is not configurable via frontmatter — builder is the main agent. Only planner and evaluator (subagents) have agent files with model: fields.
platform_constraints.sync_overwrite: make sync-local copies library/cursor/agents/ to .cursor/agents/ and overwrites customized files. Personal model: overrides in .cursor/agents/ do not survive sync unless the library source is also changed.
